prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in a cozy bedroom, beginning in a loose home look and transitioning to an elegant fashion look with a slim camisole-strap top, delicate necklace, earrings, gentle curls, and refined makeup.
prompt.composition_elements: Warm bedroom with light gentle background. Close-up camera emphasizes the contrast between relaxed home styling and refined post-transition styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cinematic soft focus, warm yellow light and shadow, warm pink low-saturation luxury grade, gentle haze, natural smooth motion.

technical_specs.quality: High-definition cinematic texture without plastic retouching.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-high-definition cinematic outfit-change short video with soft focus and soft lighting. In a cozy bedroom with a light gentle background, warm yellow light and shadow, and a warm pink low-saturation high-class tone, an adult woman begins in a lazy home look with a loose soft top, light makeup, loose gentle hair, a clean relaxed expression, and lazy natural movements. She lowers her head with a slight smile and gently strokes her hair. Complete a silky outfit change at music rhythm points with natural soft transitions and increasingly gentle hazy light. After the change, she wears an elegant slim camisole-strap top with a delicate necklace and earrings, gentle curly hairstyle, refined makeup, and a composed alluring fashion presence. Keep posture elegant and relaxed, movements soft and soothing, close-up focus stable and gentle, natural dynamics, no distortion, and no sexualized framing.
